summary: Pompano Beach Airpark is a publicly owned general aviation facility in Broward County, Florida, serving the greater Fort Lauderdale metropolitan area. Originally developed as a municipal airfield in the mid-20th century, it now caters primarily to flight training, recreational flying, and light corporate aviation. Its convenient coastal location makes it a popular destination for transient pilots exploring South Florida's Atlantic coastline.
